newsitem.title: USA: StorMedia sees Q1 net loss, same as Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: StorMedia sees Q1 net loss, same as Q3 loss.

text.p: StorMedia Inc said it expected to incur a net loss for the first quarter ended March 28 comparable to its net loss in the third quarter, because of lower sales.

The company said it expected net sales for the quarter to be about $34.1 million, below net sales for the third quarter. StorMedia, which supplies thin film disks for hard disk drives, said it expanded its customer base during the first quarter but some qualifications were not completed.
These qualification problems were being addressed, it said, adding the company saw significantly expanded net sales during the second quarter.
In the third quarter 1996, the company lost $0.52 per share. The First Call consensus earnings estimate for the first quarter was a loss of $0.17 per share.
StorMedia was not immediately available for comment.
The company said it was encouraged that the expansion of its customer and technology base would enable it to return to profitability as early as the second quarter.

"During the first quarter the company took significant steps in broadening its customer and technology base," said Chairman William Almon. "We are currently shipping in volume to three customers and ended the quarter with approximately 70 percent of our total unit shipment represented by high-performance magnetoresistive disks."
The company said it planned to release first quarter results after the market close on April 23.
